name: Boiler circulation pumps / forced-circulation pumps (HRSG, once-through, controlled circulation)
description: In forced/controlled-circulation HRSGs and boilers, a pump circulates water/steam-water mixture from the drum through parallel evaporator circuits and back, maintaining tube-wall wetting where natural density head is insufficient (horizontal tubes, limited drum-to-evaporator height, long circuits). Natural-circulation and once-through units need no circulation pump in normal operation (once-through with superimposed circulation uses one at start-up/low load).

specifications.metric: Circulation ratio rule of thumb for forced-circulation HRSG
specifications.unit: ratio (5:1 circulating flow to steam flow)
specifications.basis: Esteem Projects HRSG tutorial; 20-25% steam generation by weight is the film-boiling 'danger' zone; 3:1 may suffice where drum is far below/above evaporator
